response.query: How do developer engagement patterns interact with configuration-space complexity to predict configuration-related defects and time-to-resolution across large configurable projects?
response.answer: Developer engagement patterns correlate with configuration-space complexity to predict configuration-related defects and time-to-resolution in large configurable projects. Higher engagement often leads to fewer defects and faster resolution. Effective communication and collaboration are key.
